summary: Full E2E validation of the new photo-upload feature (backend + frontend). Backend spot checks (existing pytest suite green from iter 4 still passes): /api/auth/login returns token; /api/admin/site GET & PUT round-trip heroImageUrl/brandonPhotoUrl correctly; /api/public/{site,teams,champions,gallery} reflect saved photoUrls; /api/files/{path} returns 200 image/jpeg without auth. Frontend flows all PASS (executed via Playwright against preview URL): (1) Admin login OK. (2) ContentAdmin → site-hero-image-upload: uploaded PNG via hidden file input, preview appeared (site-hero-image-upload-preview), Save Changes → save-success; homepage / shows with src '/api/files/dalleo-open/uploads/554a1198-…png' and NO hero-image-placeholder. (3) site-brandon-photo-upload uploaded JPG → Save → /brandon renders memorial-photo-hero as (tagName IMG) and homepage BrandonSection shows brandon-photo (no brandon-photo-placeholder). (4) team-photo-upload-martin uploaded PNG → Save → /teams/martin renders with /api/files/... src. (5) champion-photo-upload-2025 uploaded JPG → Save → /champions timeline card 2025 renders champion-photo-2025 as an IMG (PhotoFrame renders directly when src is present) and /champions/2025 hero renders champion-hero-photo as IMG. (6) Gallery admin: edit g1 (original src empty) → 'Or upload a photo' (gal-upload) uploaded PNG → preview visible → Apply → Save; /gallery media-thumb-g1 renders the uploaded photo (img src /api/files/...). (7) Remove flow: site-hero-image-upload-remove clicked → Save → homepage arched frame returned to hero-image-placeholder (Tournament photo coming soon), hero-image element gone. (8) Validation: uploaded /tmp/test_bad.txt via hero upload input → site-hero-image-upload-error shown with 'Only JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF images' (backend 422 propagated correctly). (9) Public URL access: /api/files/... fetched via anonymous page.request.get → 200 image content-type (no auth required; cache-control header set). (10) FINAL CLEANUP EXECUTED (mandatory) — all four spots + gallery g1 restored to empty. Verified via /api/public endpoints: site.heroImageUrl=None, brandonPhotoUrl=None; teams.martin.photoUrl=None; champions[2025].photoUrl=None; gallery.g1.src=None. UI verified: hero-image-placeholder visible on /, brandon-photo-placeholder visible on /, memorial-photo-hero on /brandon is a DIV (placeholder), champion-photo-2025 on /champions is a DIV (placeholder), team-photo count=0 on /teams/martin. (11) Regression: /, /teams, /champions, /champions/2025, /brandon, /gallery, /leaderboard, /score all rendered with zero page/console errors. Admin sections (Content, Gallery, Champions, Teams, Scoring) all load fine.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageUpload component correctly wired: sends multipart to /api/admin/uploads with Bearer token; onChange fires with body.url from server; -preview/-remove/-error testId suffixes present.
Backend /api/admin/uploads correctly enforces content-type allowlist (returns 422 with clear message that surfaces to the UI); 12MB cap; UUID paths; db.files record inserted.
PhotoFrame elegantly renders the img element WITH the testId when src is present (so ) — test authors must check tagName, not descendant img, to verify state.
Public /api/files/{path} enforces record lookup (soft-delete respected) and adds cache-control public,max-age=86400 — good.
Same-origin relative URL pattern ('/api/files/...') stored in DB makes uploads portable across preview/production domains.
Minor: /api/admin/uploads has no rate limiting (rely on Bearer auth); acceptable for admin-only endpoint.
Minor: db.files supports soft-delete flag but there's no admin delete API or GC — main agent notes files remain in storage; acceptable per spec.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test_photo.png (orange 400x300 PNG), /tmp/test_photo2.jpg (green 400x300 JPEG), /tmp/test_bad.txt (used for negative validation). No persistent seed data left in DB — all uploads cleared per mandatory cleanup step.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
